mapper.select: select bm_ingredient_input_record.*, bm_storage_material.material_id, bm_material.specification, bm_material.name as material_name, bm_material.merge_code as material_merge_code, bm_storage_material_batch.material_batch_no as storage_material_batch_no from bm_ingredient_input_record left join bm_storage_material on bm_ingredient_input_record.storage_material_id = bm_storage_material.id left join bm_storage_material_batch on bm_storage_material.storage_material_batch_id = bm_storage_material_batch.id left join bm_material on bm_material.id = bm_storage_material.material_id where bm_ingredient_input_record.ingredient_plan_id = #{ingredientPlanId}

select bm_ingredient_input_record.*, bm_storage_material.material_id, bm_material.specification, bm_material.name as material_name, bm_material.merge_code as material_merge_code, bm_storage_material_batch.material_batch_no as storage_material_batch_no from bm_ingredient_input_record left join bm_storage_material on bm_ingredient_input_record.storage_material_id = bm_storage_material.id left join bm_storage_material_batch on bm_storage_material.storage_material_batch_id = bm_storage_material_batch.id left join bm_material on bm_material.id = bm_storage_material.material_id where bm_ingredient_input_record.component_instance_id = #{componentInstanceId}
